reviews.text: So I’m going to start this off by disclaiming that I have a lot of physical illnesses and this could be a life changer for me, but being disabled and low income I can’t afford to buy the actual band that tracks everything. I wish this would be more affordable and accessible to people like me who actually really need it to monitor the day to day stress tole

reviews.title: Excellent neurodivergent biofeedback for managing Autistic burnout
reviews.text: I've been struggling with chronic pain and "mystery" symptoms that my doctors struggled to understand since ~1997. I've been a patient or interdisciplinary pain clinics, rehab therapies, every type of voluntary psychiatric crisis stabilization from inpatient hospitalization to residential alternatives to intensive outpatient programs. I have done DBT, MBSR, MBCT for treatment-resistant depression, somatic experiencing therapies for trauma, acupuncture, and virtually everything under the sun and moon for "psychosomatic" symptoms. Visible is the best app I have ever used for real-time biofeedback. I did my first neuropsychiatric evaluation in my life at the beginning of 2025 and discovered that I am Autistic and ADHD with severe PTSD and some related secondary diagnoses (social anxiety, situational phobias related to sensory overwhelm, etc). Visible is the best tool I have found for understanding in real time (and analyzing trends over weeks or months or years) for when I experience Autistic burnout/meltdowns/shutdowns and I highly recommend this app to anyone who is neurodivergent or suspects they might be. (Note that per peer-reviewed research, all of the conditions that Visible helps track as of June 2025 are common comorbidities of Autism spectrum diagnoses.)

reviews.title: A life saver, literally
reviews.text: I suffer from long covid and me/cfs - the fatigue and need to pace are relentless. I have been told by doctors to not let my heart rate rise over 93 and without visible I was just guessing based on after the fact readings. This app is helping me understand my body’s reactions and helping me pace more effectively. I am in such a better place because of visible.

reviews.title: Fibromyalgia
reviews.text: This is the app for fibromyalgia patients. It lets you know what your energy quotient is for the day so you can plan accordingly. I wouldn’t want to be without this app!! My daughter also has fibromyalgia and is using this app. Highly recommended!!

reviews.title: Very Helpful
reviews.text: I find this app helpful in managing chronic illness.

reviews.title: Not Just for ME/CFS & Long Covid
reviews.text: Very thankful that this app exists because it helps me so much with pacing aka “counting my spoons.” The app is very easy to use and understand, and I love that the armband 2.0 has a charge that actually lasts 5 days (serious upgrade from charging it every night). I’ve become more intimidated about my energy cycles and my condition after using this app. If you have any energy limiting illness, this app could be of benefit to you.

reviews.title: Life saver
reviews.text: This has been crucial in my ability to learn pacing, see symptoms, prove symptoms, and start dialog with my physician in requesting and getting approved for genetic testing for my invisible chronic illness’s also once I’ve learned how to use this and keep track of my symptoms, I can almost see when a major flare will come. I also love that it alerted me for over doing it instead of always being told to do more. I hope that this program will expand to more than long COVID diagnoses and get centered in other illnesses such as dysautonomia or chronic pain documentation.

reviews.title: life changing
reviews.text: being able to physically see and track my pace points has literally changed my life. i honestly dont know what i did before Visible. being able to get and stay ahead of flare ups has given me back a part of my life that i have missed for so long. 🩷

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I love mine so much! We got it first for my fibromyalgia and being able to tell when i was starting to over do it, BUT since we got it I started having heart problems and so it is now tracking those issues! I dont ever want to have to live without it now.

reviews.title: Game changer for managing chronic illness
reviews.text: The real time data and the format that Visible has created is invaluable. It has been so helpful with understanding what is actually going on with my health during day-to-day activities. The HRV information is also very helpful as well as the breathing excerise to support it. Customer service is personable and so helpful. Truly worth every single dollar.

reviews.title: Useful
reviews.text: Great for identifying patterns and letting me verify what I am feeling. Highly recommended if you would benefit from learning to pace yourself and identify your body’s patterns better (which is really true for basically everyone).

reviews.title: Best helper
reviews.text: I have several auto immune diseases. Visible is helping me to learn when I am over exerting myself and to take a rest. Best tool I have ever used.

reviews.title: Really good for pacing
Life Long POTS Haver
reviews.text:
I have had POTS since my early teens and nothing has given me the sense of freedom that Visible does. 
Being able to track my symptoms and log my crashes has showed me obvious patterns that I’ve been able to acknowledge and help better my quality of life. 
The pacing feature is so spot on, it’s kind of scary!! And without fail if I wake up with a bad HRV I know I’m in for a really tough day (or four).

My 4 stars is because I have a lot of trouble with my armband staying connected. I would rate a 4.9 if I could, because the disconnecting is worth it when I get to have all the other benefits!!

reviews.title: Game Changer
reviews.text: I have Dysautonomia with IST and OI and the Visible app plus the polar armband has given me concrete data I need to understand what is going on in my body in real time since my body loses it's ability to respond normally during flares. I have also found it helpful to show loved ones so they can see how different activities impact me internally even when I look fine on the outside.

reviews.title: A Helpful Tracker for Pacing
reviews.text: As someone with several complex chronic conditions affecting multiple body systems, the Visible armband is very helpful in better understanding my body and budgeting energy for the day. The app is simple to use and comes with live access to dedicated people who help you tweak the settings to meet your individual situation and needs.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: It has been very illuminating to be able to connect how much I’m doing, how I’m feeling and what my heart rate actually is. I have POTS so it is a bit harder to untangle physical exertion from just being in an upright position but it still helps a lot. For instance seeing heart rate changes lets me know if it’s an especially POTSY day or not. I do wish the heart rate monitor worked perfectly but unfortunately it gets disconnected easily. Luckily the new 2.0 stores data so you don’t lose it when it reconnects. Unfortunately sometimes it’s glitchy and gives clearly false heart rate but luckily only happens occasionally (maybe couple times a day).

reviews.title: Use this if you have POTS/PEM, long covid etc
reviews.text: I tried different mainstream HR tracking  devices (Fitbit, Garmin) to manage chronic fatigue, post exertional malaise, POTS and other long covid symptoms. None of them worked for me but Visible does. It’s the only HR tracker designed with sick people in mind afaik. Just be aware that it has limitations, including that the armband itself doesn’t buzz, vibrate or display data. You need to have your phone on hand with the app running at all times. Also, it’s quite expensive  at the time of this writing and insurers won’t cover it.

reviews.title: Great for pacing!
reviews.text: I have MECFS from long covid. Visible helps me a lot with managing my pacing for orthostatic intolerance, dysautonomia, and PEM. There are a lot of things that make my heart rate go up that I didn’t realize until I had visible! I am able to stay within my limits physically and have avoided causing PEM from physical activity.

reviews.title: A spoonie’s best friend
reviews.text: This tracker has been incredibly helpful for getting me back on track with both with pots and having multiple chronic conditions.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text:
I appreciate that there is an app created to help me pace myself. Having Multiple Sclerosis and Long Covid I tend not be sure when to slow down and if what symptom that I’m having is causing a flare up. I love that I can track my symptoms and the severity. 
I highly recommend if you have a long term chronic illness and need help with pacing your energy.

reviews.title: Literally makes an invisible condition visible
reviews.text:
I was worried this wouldn’t be worth trying, but this app has been great to see actual data about how my body is affected by different conditions! It’s really helpful personally but also to show people to be like NO LITERALLY LOOK AT WHAT MY HEART IS DOING FOR “NO GOOD REASON” lol 
Also, very helpful for when you’re trying out new medications! With a chronic illness, it can be hard when the doctor follows up on new meds asking “how do you feel?” And you do the whole, how /do/ I feel? Maybe a little better? Maybe that’s just wishful thinking? I still don’t feel better, idk?? I don’t remember how I felt last week or month??
With this app I have good detailed heart rate data and consistent symptom tracking to look at

reviews.title: So valuable
reviews.text: I am learning to recognize patterns it never occurred to me to observe. It’s allowing me to gauge how much strength I have in reserve. It shows me important measurements that my medical providers need to know also! I think this would be valuable for fibromyalgia as well.

reviews.title: Great for long Covid
reviews.text: I have a hard time remembering how I felt a week or a month ago. Using this app briefly in the morning and evening has given me a measurable indicator of how well I’m doing over time. I love looking at the graphs and seeing how my different symptoms change over time.

reviews.title: Helps you learn to pace more effectively
reviews.text: I have fibromyalgia, because of this I suffer with chronic pain and debilitating fatigue.  The armband paired with the app serves as a constant reminder to pace myself.  It also helps me to understand which activities use more pace points than others.  I have found it helpful in my ongoing pacing journey.

reviews.title: So happy to have this in my life
reviews.text: I have struggled with pacing since being diagnosed with fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue syndrome. I was skeptical of this device since I never really liked spoon theory and thought this was just that. But it is so much more. It may seem silly to say that I didn’t know I was exerting myself when I brushed my teeth but I was. Tasks that I do everyday were exerting me and I continued doing everything else on top of that because I couldn’t see what was draining me. Now I can.

reviews.title: They do a lot of great thing but could do more
reviews.text: So visible is great at helping with pacing but it could be better at tracking thing like when symptoms happen for many people with chronic conditions what they and how much they drink also have an effect on their symptoms as yet visible does not have a way to track theses thing it as simple fix for them all they need to do is add a food diary section to track the food and all they need to track symptoms better is realtime check ins not just on a 1-4 scale how much these symptoms effect you thing but a way to actually mark when symptoms happen like a listing the symptoms and check box with an intensity of 1-10 scale this can give doctors more data like whether or not a condition is truly under control so while I recommend this as part of your routine for tracking things I do not recommend it be your only tool.

reviews.title: Valuable tool for Long Covid!
reviews.text: Best management tool bringing some level of predictability in a completely unpredictable world.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text:
I take my iPad to Physical Therapy and my therapist can see in real time how I’m doing and we can make sure I don’t overdo it. Before the app, I would do 
PT for 2 or 3 weeks and have to stop due to PEM from over exertion.  I was able to go weekly for over a year with the help of the app.

reviews.title: Pacing tools for heart damage from chemotherapy
reviews.text:
My heart was damaged during chemotherapy treatment, and I’ve been in a state of tachycardia over a year. 

Visible helps me pace my energy and helps me avoid dangerous crashes.

My physical therapy uses the heart rate to determine duration and intensity during workouts.

I’m happy with it.

reviews.title: PotsieMom
reviews.text: It helps so much with managing my pace levels that I don’t wipe myself out and get stuck in bed recovering

reviews.title: Helped to diagnosis
reviews.text: Hashimoto’s, POTSie amongst other things here. I knew I had chronic fatigue before I got visible. I had had it about a month when I woke up and my resting heart rate was in the 80s, stood and it was in the 130s. The data helped my doctor get my tilt table test and my POTS diagnosis. I’m grateful to visible. It helps me pace and lean into rest.

reviews.title: Great so far!
reviews.text: Been using visible for a couple months now and really enjoy the live tracking. Only thing I wish it also had would be sleep tracking to see how that plays a role in my symptoms.

reviews.title: Visible arm band
reviews.text: I do love my visible arm band for my POTs. being able to see my heart rate in real time has been a big help. The only thing, i don’t like is the battery life. It says it will hold charge for 5 days, but mine has only been able to do about two or three

reviews.title: FINALLY! Invisible illnesses made Visible
reviews.text:
This app has truly been life-changing. I’ve had it now for six months and I feel like I finally have a way to monitor myself with some predictability. Getting my morning stability score lets me set my expectations for the day as to what I can do vs what I should not do. I used to just push through adverse symptoms of fatigue, dizziness, and irritability, but with the data from this app, it grants me permission to give myself grace when I need to rest.
***This app makes me feel good about taking care of myself rather than making me feel bad that I didn’t reach a “step goal” for the day.*** It also helps me track my symptoms and observe trends I didn’t know were there. 
Overall, I love this app and have been extremely pleased with the effect it has had on my life.

reviews.title: Invaluable Resource
reviews.text: I suffer from Long COVID and POTS and I would not be doing nearly as well as I am without the Visible app and wearable. This tool allows me to better understand and manage my health day to day.

reviews.title: A Must Have App for POTS and CFS
reviews.text: This app has been a game changer for me. I was so used to just go go go and pushing through life prior to my cancer diagnosis and subsequent POTS and CFS. This app gives me real time info on my energy usage to better help prepare for tasks and prevent crashes. It has helped me in the difficult process of pacing when it wasn’t an innate skill of mine.

reviews.title: Makes the invisible symptoms visible 🖤
reviews.text: I love this device. it is incredibly validating to use. when I feel worse, I can see it in the data as well. This helps me become better at understanding and managing my symptoms.

reviews.title: So helpful for pacing
reviews.text: I’ve been using Visible to help me learn how to pace, in order my manage my Long COVID/POTS, and ME/CFS. It has been incredibly helpful to see what activities use a lot of pace points, and to set a daily budget of points. I’ve learned what activities to avoid, reschedule, or modify. It’s greatly improved my ability to manage my conditions. I highly recommend it to anyone who lives with an energy-limiting condition.

reviews.title: Small band = Big miracle
reviews.text: For most of my life, I’ve always had the dizzy spells when I would stand up and have to brace myself with the wall or doorway and really, just thinking that was a normal way to stand up. And it wasn’t until just recently approaching my mid 50s, I realize this was not normal. Menopause has brought on some health changes with pots that I didn’t even know I had until it landed me in the hospital. When I came across this lovely device and it has forever changed my life and changed my life for the better. It has made visible to my doctors What I have felt going on inside me and helped get a better diagnosis and helped me plan my day and help. Keep me safe while I’m working on those around me.. I can’t say enough about this product. It is worth every penny I paid. This is hands-down. One of the best devices I have ever come across. It does exactly what it says and I think that if anyone is having second thoughts, don’t overthink this go ahead and get it and you will see why those of us that have left. These reviews are doing so it is absolutely life-changing for the better thank goodness for this company and the people that have created this.

reviews.title: All knowledge is power at this point
reviews.text: The visible system has allowed me to accurately see where my energy does-and does NOT-go. I have not only found when to stop certain activities, I have discovered activities that are actually ‘rest’ for me. It’s given me more freedom and independence.

reviews.title: Best Device!
reviews.text: If you are a Spoonie or have a chronic illnesses..this is the best device to manage your day. It will help you forecast your body’s energy ahead of time and plan for the best use of your time and attention. Spend less days in bed!

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text: This device has absolutely changed my ability to understand and communicate my illness (for the better). I’ve been able to see, track, and explain my dysautonomia episodes so much better and understand what has been impacting me most heavily.

reviews.title: A must have to get control over your life
reviews.text: This has been an invaluable tool for me this last eight months… Little did I know that I would become bedbound and need to be able to calibrate my energy carefully to support my recovery. My doctors relied on my ability to informe them of my heart rate, my resting my exertion on my sleep. It gave me a sense of control and I am sure it was part of me getting vertical once again. Happy to say I have been walking and back in the world still using my armband to keep me making safe decisions to ensure that I don’t overdo and keep my recovery on pace! Thank you Visib!e!

reviews.title: guys. this has helped so much.
reviews.text: as someone with POTS, mast cell activation, endometriosis, and PCOS (as well as possibly narcolepsy and/or SVT.. tbd tbd.. hopefully not *cries*) this app is the first thing that has actually helped me put physical data to my chronic illness in a way that i (and the people closest to me) can understand. it helps me manage my limitations while also enabling me to monitor my energy to get the most out of my days, without causing my body to crash out or deteriorate quicker than it already is. the team all genuinely care and the armband/app duo are clear and easy to use. seriously, it is worth the price point. if you are considering it, let this be your sign. you deserve the help and you deserve to feel seen. ❦

reviews.title: helpful and hopeful
reviews.text: This app has been incredibly helpful on my health journey. I felt so alone in my invisible illness, and I found it hard to manage and track my daily symptoms. This app helps give me a check on where I am each day, helping me pace myself throughout the day. I feel like I can control some of the narrative about how I talk about my health as I continue to get the treatment I need. This app gives me hope as I navigate my health journey.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: This has allowed me to see how much I push myself.

reviews.title: Has helped me so much!
reviews.text: The app and device combo has given me the data I need to avoid crashes and manage my energy. It’s like having an angel on my shoulder reminding me to pace myself. I don’t ever want to go back to managing my hEDS without it.

reviews.title: Powerful tool
reviews.text:
This app and armband have been incredibly helpful and powerful in helping me understand how my body is handling Long Covid and ME/CFS. The real-time data with the armband is so eye-opening and I finally feel like I have a little bit of control over illnesses that have felt out of my control. 

I was on the fence for a couple years about upgrading to the subscription and armband, and I only wish I had just gone for it because it has absolutely been worth it.

reviews.title: Life changer
reviews.text: I should have gotten the band + subscription sooner!

reviews.title: An absolute game-changer
reviews.text: This app changed my life and made dealing with ME/CFS actually possible. Before Visible everything was just guesswork, now it’s easy to pace myself.

reviews.title: Prevent over-doing it
reviews.text: The app pairs with a Polar heart rate monitor and opens a wealth of information to help manage energy limitations. It is helping me prevent setbacks and worsening, wonderful tool in the chronic illness journey

reviews.title: Excellent health aid
reviews.text: I use Visible to help me keep my energy use under my safe biophysical limit. It helps me pace myself through each day. I also use it to communicate how I'm doing with my family and close friends so they have reasonable expectations for what I'll likely be able to do on any given day.

reviews.title: Energy Saving!!!!
reviews.text: I was diagnosed with CFS/ME (long covid) and fibromyalgia a little over a year ago after months of trying to figure out why I was so fatigued all the time. I had a major crash in Feb of 2024 and discovered Visible in May after my diagnosis. It has taught me so much and it really helps me explain my illness to anyone in my life and help them understand. My biggest fear is having another major crash (I am still recovering from the last one), but with visible I can see how my body is doing and it keeps me from over doing it on good days and it tells me when to take it easy on bad days. It’s another great way to see what is happening with my body and my symptoms. It’s been very helpful. I tell everyone with chronic illness about it.

reviews.title: Critical tool for pacing
reviews.text: I have POTS, ME, hEDS and Long Covid (which worsened all of these conditions). Visible has been essential for learning to pace. In addition to medication and other interventions, Visible has helped improve my functional capacity by showing me when I need to rest. I’m very grateful for this app.

reviews.title: Must have
reviews.text: I have FND which includes many symptoms that limit my energy and affect my heart rate. viable has helped me gain control of my health better than drs opinions.

reviews.title: Very helpful for pacing
reviews.text: Visible app has helped me up my pacing game tremendously. Having an audible alert when I am nearing my anaerobic threshold heart rate is super helpful. As being able to see in the graphic format when I’m in rest and when I’m in activity and exertion is super helpful. Also theThe energy budget helps me as well. In addition, the staff is responsive and very helpful.

reviews.title: POTS/MCAS/Sjogrens
reviews.text: This helps me substantially to recognize when I need to rest, what activities use the most energy, and with understanding how my body works against me.

reviews.title: Honestly super good!
reviews.text: I cant obsess over my hr like i do with my apple watch, I will say the readings are less accurate than the apple watch but it still does its job! I like that I cant always have the app open if i want to do other things and the auto threshold adjustments are great!

reviews.title: The Armband is Worth It!
reviews.text:
I started using Visible because I have POTS and NMH, both caused by Long Covid. I used it without the armband at first and found it helpful, but wanted to see if it was worth investing in the armband. It was! The pacing function is so helpful in my day-to-day life. I already use an Apple Watch, but this provides different insights to my day. I like being able to categorize my activities in relation to my heart rate because then I can reflect on what is happening and how it affects my energy and how I’m feeling on a particular day. It also helps me be more mindful about what I’m doing and how I’m exerting myself.

I just want to thank the developers for creating this app! It’s so helpful.

reviews.title: Best app for chronically ill people
reviews.text: This app gives me so much data!! After visiting doctor after doctor for 10 years I was finally diagnosed with POT, hEDS and MCAS. The visible app helps me track my heart rate issues so that I’m able to track my energy and have fewer flare ups. It also lets me tag my activities so that I know what is over exerting me. The evening tracker helps me keep track of all my numerous symptoms medications. The best part is that when I go into my doctors appointments I’ve got real time data to show them exactly how my body was feeling on a given day and what my heart was doing during certain activities. If you have an energy limiting disability or chronic illness like POTS this app is a must have! The visible team is also amazing and has helped me replace charging cables with ease! 🧂🦓💜

reviews.title: Pacing A+
reviews.text: I am not very good at pacing myself and knowing when I need to pause and when I’ve done too much and need to stop. Visible has made living with my chronic illnesses possible by avoiding consequences of over exertion. I am able to go outside and do things with this app and I am so grateful.

reviews.title: Long covid tracking
reviews.text: This app was really a game changer for me in dealing with my long COVID. It helps me pace and track my symptoms. Visible Plus has been great to let me keep track of my pacing minute by minute instead of just at the end of the day. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Helpful!
reviews.text: Very helpful to me for monitoring my exertion level each day to help me guard against over-extending myself; it that way it helps me avoid a crash (post-exertional malaise, etc.).

reviews.title: Use this for Lyme Disease
reviews.text: I have been using Visible for almost a year. It has been very useful for knowing how to pace my day since I have a chronic illness, Lyme Disease. I have very limited energy throughout the day and Visible lets me know when my heart rate is above normal and suggests that I take a break. It makes it so much easier for me to pace my day. I really like Visible and it helps me SO much.  I am glad there is someone out there helping people in the chronic illness space because really it seems like there is no one most of the time.

reviews.title: Unpairs so loose data frequently
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend unless you have time to constantly pair your polar with your iPhone. They unpair all the time and the help desk will treat you as the problem and send the same video to pair the two constantly. Both are maddening. Save yourself the headache of another gaslighting experience and buy a more reliable app.

reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.text: I used to use Visible to know when to sit down for a few minutes before continuing my activities, now my heart has gotten far worse off, so I use Visible to monitor it. It’s good to always see where my heart is at and when I need to rest and to monitor how high it gets. I’m still working on pacing since I need to figure out alternative ways to do tasks but having Visible is still a big help. Plus I can always see what activities exhaust me the most, like doing laundry or walking too much. I’ll definitely be referring to my data on the app when I see my cardiologist again, thank you Visible! :)

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: I don’t want to be without my Visible armband. Not only does it help with pacing, it helps with symptom tracking and helping me show my doctors what’s going on with my sy symptoms. I am still learning about all this app has to offer.

reviews.title: Helpful Tool for Chronic Health Issue
reviews.text: Highly recommend this app & band.  I began first using the free version of the app then realized I did need the band.  So glad I took that plunge because it has much more data tracking and has truly helped me keep more stable throughout my days.

reviews.title: Full-time heart monitoring
reviews.text: I have been using Visible for going on 2 years. This is my ride or die app for monitoring my heart rate - and I can see how when I use too many points a couple days, I go down. I am learning to adjust my life using Visible to try to stay healthier for longer periods. I love how you can set your own heart rate targets and your own energy points. Nothing is one size fits all except the armband!

reviews.title: Great for neurodivergency and chronic illness (which often occur together!)
reviews.text: Visible helps me monitor my energy and make decisions about managing my autism and sensory processing differences. I can also track my symptoms and heart rate in real time which helped me get my chronic illness diagnosed!

reviews.title: Saved My Life!
reviews.text: This app changed my life. I’ve gone from severe me/cfs to moderate because I learned how to pace. I’m no longer going into PEM.

reviews.title: So helpful
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this device not only does it do everything promised and make it easy for your healthcare team and yourself but customer service is great they respond quickly and it’s easy to talk to them as it’s just a message on the app

reviews.title: Revolutionary to Accepting Limitations from Chronic Illness
reviews.text: The data from Visible is unlike any other biometric device and has allowed me to accept my limitations. I use to beat myself up for not being able to meet my ambition. For years I’ve been disappointed in myself but now I am coming to a place of acceptance of those limitations rather than fighting them. I also have GAD and the awareness of how much stress and anxiety does impact my body has been major.

reviews.title: Helpful app for energy-limiting illness
reviews.text: Very helpful for identifying my fatigue triggers and noticing when my body is starting to struggle, rather than waiting until I’m already in a crash! Everything else is aimed at healthy people trying to improve performance, and I appreciate having a tool for those of us who need to limit activity instead.

reviews.title: Helpful monitoring
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app and this monitor for about seven months. It’s helped me understand a lot more about living with chronic illness and how to set boundaries. I can manage my energy expenditure and track my symptoms. It has become another tool in my toolbox. It has helped me come to terms with the fact that there’s no cure but there is optimal management of my chronic illness. The tracking piece of it helps me navigate my symptoms giving me insight and how best to set boundaries and maintain quality of life.
It’s easy to use and helps my doctors and I navigate management of the symptoms that I deal with on a daily basis. It’s comfortable enough to wear every day and the battery life is decent. The app is self-explanatory that makes me focus on myself in the beginning and the end of my day.

reviews.title: Even old dogs can learn new tricks
reviews.text: I’ve been diagnosed with ME/CFS for over two decades yet I’ve still learned new things about my body and illness since using Visible.

reviews.title: The best app for pacing, hands down.
reviews.text: Lots of apps track the same metrics, but the difference is in how Visible presents the data and the support they share in the community section. Recovery from acute illness or living with a chronic condition requires a different mindset than training for a marathon or other fitness goal. Visible gets that, and frames the data in a way that feels empowering and encouraging as much as it is practical and useful. I recommend this app to anyone who struggles to pace themselves consistently or is stuck in a cycle of push-crash-push-crash. It really helps to quantify the peaks and valleys in your energy levels so you can be smart and intentional about choosing when to exert and when to rest. That consistency and leveling out those peaks & valleys has made a huge difference in how I feel and what I am able to do. It’s also really satisfying to see the impact of my efforts reflected in my daily stability score. Thank you, Visible!!!

reviews.title: Great tool for people struggling with POTS
reviews.text: I have been using this armband for a couple of months and it is a great tool! I have been in a constant “flair” for three years and have been very limited with my activity tolerance and PEM. I’ve also had a hard time determining any triggers. Of course I can feel it when I am getting tired while doing something, but the constant monitoring by this armband gives me alerts before I feel tired so I can take a break earlier and then don’t have to deal with the crash when I push myself too far. The symptom/medicine/etc tracker is also great so I can look back and try to determine triggers/trends. I have been looking for something like this for a long time and am very happy with it!

reviews.title: Useful and Validating
reviews.text: None of my friends, family, or coworkers share my invisible illness, so no one really understands what I am going through. I would never wish my painful experience on anyone, but it is lonely and confusing to navigate on my own. Visible has given me data and language to understand my boundaries and needs, and to communicate them effectively. I can’t express how life changing that is! I feel more confident to try new things on days when I can see in Visible that I have energy and inner resources, and having my data to explain to others when I need to rest has improved my relationships. It also helps me understand myself so I can communicate better with my doctors, and get more accurate care. Plus it costs less than some medical tests! Just because others can’t see our pain, does not mean it’s “only in our head.” Anyone with an energy limiting illness will benefit from Visible!

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: Visable has helped a lot with intentional pacing and having data to share with my cardiologist.

reviews.title: So valuable for Chronic Illnesses!!!
reviews.text: I’ve been a member with Visible for quite some time now (at least over a year) and it is so helpful for someone like me who has multiple chronic illnesses. I have such a difficult time trying to manage pacing on my own, but Visible makes it significantly easier. The morning check-in helps to highlight how active I can be that day and the monthly check-ins help to show if there is any improvement or deconditioning with my conditions. This is super helpful so I can talk with my doctors if there are any downward trends. If you have any of the chronic illnesses listed under what they service, get Visible!!! It’ll help so much!

reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.text: Honestly, I love this band. It knows when I’m not feeling well by doing my morning stability and so far it’s been right every time. On the days my morning stability is low, my symptoms are high so I know to pace myself. I highly recommend the arm band I love it.

reviews.title: Really helpful/seeing improvement
reviews.text: After being extremely limited by long Covid for 2 1/2 years, this app is finally helping me see some mild and steady improvement!

reviews.title: Life saver!
reviews.text: Have been ill with Fibromyalgia and CFS/ME for 30 years. I thought I was pacing well but Visible took it to a whole new level! Recently I noticed a change in my usual heart rate, took it to my doctor and we were able to diagnose developing heart disease and start treatment Before a crisis could happen! Truly a life saver! Thanks

reviews.title: Excellent for ME/CFS
reviews.text: I have mild/moderate ME/CFS and use this app every day. Perfect for heart rate, symptom, and medication tracking to help me pace and identify what causes crashes. Band big enough to fit around my thigh so that I can wear sleeveless shirts in summer. Only thing missing is HRV tracking throughout the day.

reviews.title: Encouraged
reviews.text: My acupuncturist encouraged me to try visible because of my post exertional malaise. I was reticent to try yet another app. But it has been so helpful teaching me how to pace myself and went to rest and restore my energy. After several months of use I am slowly regaining energy and feeling better!

reviews.title: Revolutionary for Energy Limiting Conditions
reviews.text: I’ve been using Visible’s premium subscription for the past 7 months now, and I would not have it any other name. This app is revolutionary for energy limiting conditions.

reviews.title: Incredibly valuable informative tool
reviews.text: I've been using visible app/monitor for almost a year. I have learned so much from this tool about pacing myself for energy. Without it, i would be lost! energy is low for unknown reasons, but I'm learning how to manage my energy for my daily life. I'm so grateful for the device, the knowledge, the detailed information! Anyone struggling with lack of energy should give this a try.

reviews.title: Fine Tuning
reviews.text: Even someone like myself who has decades of experience with pacing and tracking symptoms can benefit greatly from this app. My symptoms changed a lot during perimenopause, which made me feel lost and hopeless. This app helped  me see where I need to adjust and gave me specific data to provide my doctors. For instance, my average resting HR became significantly higher so I was able to share the data and easily justify the need for a new medication, which immensely improved my quality of life.

reviews.title: Fascinating Data
reviews.text: I have had trouble pacing myself (CFS) and never realized how much my thoughts and emotions could affect my heart rate so dramatically. Visible has enabled me to rethink how my mind and body work together.

reviews.title: Life-changing!
reviews.text: Visible is truly life-changing if you have CFS/ME, Long Covid, etc. I have had CFS for 17 years and have been using Visible for a little over a year. If I had Visible when I first got sick, it would have saved me literal years that I spent trying to feel my way through pacing by listening to every nuance of my body (which was exhausting in its own right). Even after all of these years of pacing on my own, I have learned so much from using Visible: most importantly what I can control and what I cannot. It has empowered me but also freed me from a sense of guilt that I’m doing things wrong or not pacing well enough. I am also so grateful for the medical studies that are being done in conjunction with Visible. I feel like that alone makes this app a game changer for people living with invisible illnesses.

reviews.title: POTSIE GIRL
reviews.text: I have a few chronic illnesses but my POTS is the main one. With visible I’m able to see what activity takes the most energy also the morning check in to let me know how I should navigate the day ahead is so awesome. I love this and you will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: My family can finally SEE what I’m experiencing internally. 12/10 recommend🥹🤍
reviews.text:
This app is a literal lifesaver for people in the chronic illness community- most especially those new to this who are trying to understand what the heck their body is now doing. 

It’s so hard to adjust and stay on top of self awareness too once you hit that chronic illness wall. Nothing is ever the going to be the same, but our brains don’t understand the disconnect with our bodies.

This wearable technology has given me tangible information where I have finally been able to show family members the collected data and where my stamina and stability is wildly different from how it used to be. 

It would actually be super helpful if family members used this technology and software as well so that they can actually see the difference in comparison with their own body and collected data in comparison to their family member who has gone through a massive change and no longer has the same capacity. 

Seeing the differences between them will be truly eye opening.

reviews.title: Visible has changed my life for the better!
reviews.text: Hello! I have never written a review before but I wanted to for Visible because it’s made a huge positive impact on my life. I got a Visible before being diagnosed with POTS but I knew I had heart rate fluctuations. Visible has been so beneficial for me with finding my limits and realizing what happens when I go past them. The morning stability score helps to prepare me mentally for the day. Sometimes I score low and I’m unable to have a restful day. With the knowledge of the low score I am mentally prepared for a symptom flare up/crash. Visible tracks my heart rate every minute which is so beneficial when my heart rate fluctuates as much as it does. I also have really enjoyed being able to input tasks and determine how many spoons (energy) that task uses. Overall I’ve really enjoyed Visible! I think it is most beneficial for those who have a dysautonomia and/or want to consistently track their energy levels and how that correlates to their symptoms. I highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Pots
reviews.text: I’ve been using the armband and app for about 10 months and it’s amazing. The armband is a life changer; I can see how my body is being affected with the constant heart rate tracking and the pace points. The evening check ins really help keep track of my daily symptoms and the health reports summarize all that info. Overall, it helps me see my progresses and regresses, visually see how different things affect me, and helps me (attempt to🙃) stay on top on my health.

reviews.title: Best resource for invisible illnesses especially Long COVID, CFS/ME, POTS
reviews.text:
I am so grateful for this device. It is life changing. With Long COVID it is so easy to feel like I’m making things up or to be told I’m exaggerating. Visible allows me to have evidence and to make pacing changes that improve my health. This has improved my life!
Everyone should try it.

reviews.title: ME/CFS
reviews.text: Visible has really helped me manage my energy so I can use it for the things I want to do instead of minutiae.

reviews.title: Excellent tool to learn and track your limits
reviews.text: I don’t look disabled. That makes it easy for me to shame myself when I can’t do what others can. There are days that I feel great - until I hit the supermarket. Before I can even finish half of my shopping, I’m having mental fogs and weakness. It’s easy to look at myself as this happens and be frustrated by my limits. But visible helps me track my symptoms and helps remind myself how to manage my illness. I love it.

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: Since I started using visible, I’m able to understand my limits and how specific activities effect my energy. Can’t live without it

reviews.title: Great for Avoiding Crashes
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Visible app with the heart rate monitor for nearly two years. It’s been incredible for helping me manage both my POTS and ME/CFS.  I’ve been able to avoid crashes by monitoring my symptoms and keeping an eye on trends. Plus, I’ve been able to show up to 6 months of data to my doctors to help make adjustments to treatments, allowing for better quality of life. I can’t recommend this app and HR monitoring system enough to those with POTS and/or ME/CFS.

reviews.title: Really Useful
reviews.text:
Visible has been really useful to me so far and has helped a lot with managing my energy levels on a daily basis. I only rate it 4 stars because I think there are still many features that could be added or improved. I left feedback about this features already in a user survey, but I’ll reiterate my thoughts here:

-More flexibility with logging symptoms and medications throughout the day. I have ADHD and often forget to do my evening check in, or I only remember very late at night when I am tired and have a hard time recalling everything I want to record.

-More customization options for pacing budgets. I work part time and usually spend 2-3x the amount of pace points on days that I work compared to my days off when I am resting and recovering. The option to select specific days of the week to have different budgets would be really helpful for managing my energy around my work schedule. I would also like the option to recalibrate a suggested pace point budget based on more recent data. My first few days using the armband happened to be days where I was very inactive, so my initial budget was very low and it took me a long time to figure out and manually set a more optimal budget for myself.

-An option to have the morning check-in automatically start at a certain time without having to manually go into the app to start it. I frequently have very little time to get ready in the morning and forget about or don’t have time to start my morning check-in. I know the results may be less accurate if I happen to be sleeping or getting ready when the check-in starts, but I would rather have less accurate data than no data at all.

reviews.title: Visible is the best. I highly recommend this for anyone with an energy limiting condition.
reviews.text: Visible is the best help for pacing and understanding my condition day by day.

reviews.title: Good for physical PEM but not mental
reviews.text: This does a great job at tracking your physical energy expenditure. For myself, my PEM is caused by mental activity, so it doesn’t really help me with that.  The support and information from the site is very helpful.

reviews.title: A health tracker that doesn’t shame you (finally!)
reviews.text:
After being diagnosed with POTS/CFS I really wanted to keep an eye on my pacing (because unlearning and re-learning how quickly—or slowly—to do literally everything is a *lot* harder than anyone says, even people who warn you it’s going to be really, really hard) but all the fitness trackers I could find were geared toward encouraging activity and ensuring periods of high cardiac activity, instead of, you know, exactly the opposite of that. So when I (somehow???? can’t exactly remember, thanks persistent brain fog and memory loss!) came across the Visible app, I *smashed* that order and subscribe button, oh yeah. 

It’s definitely been more helpful than getting chastised about sitting around for too long, and I really love being able to make notes about specific activities that impact my heart rate; I really love that the app functions as sort of a daily symptom journal in general, since I don’t have the capacity to keep a separate record. It is pretty easy to get wrapped up in obsessing over your own biometrics, though, so be warned.

In general, I’m thrilled an app like this exists! I’m hopeful that there will continue to be more incorporation of biometrics to go along with the self-reported data (hopefully more HRV access, maybe a pedometer? maybe an oximeter? am I asking for the moon? it’s possible). Also replacement armbands! I ordered one from whatever that other company is, but it’s orange, and bulky, and frankly I do not like it. Thanks!

reviews.title: This app got me my diagnosis
reviews.text: My doctors were apathetic and wrote me off as anxious and this app helped me because numbers are irrefutable. It also helped me to get medicine due to the diagnosis. It’s changed my life. I recommend this to everyone.

reviews.title: Perfect for many chronic illnesses
reviews.text: I was skeptical that it wouldn’t help me much since I don’t have POTS or long Covid. I have Lupus (SLE), hypothyroidism, and ITP. But it genuinely helps me pace myself and it’s fantastic to have the data to show my specialists. The only thing I wish it had was a way to track my blood pressure and temperature readings. Right now I enter those into the notes section but it would be great to have a dedicated section and the ability to graph them out to show my doctors.

reviews.title: The wellness tool I never knew I needed!
reviews.text:
I’ve been ill and permanently disabled for 3 years now (I’m 64). People (PT, doctors, etc.) telling me that going outside and walking would increase my energy and decrease my shortness of breath, anxiety, and depression. To heck with the fact that I can barely walk from my bedroom to the kitchen and back without such severe pain that I am nauseated, plus I frequently lose my balance, and I don’t want to fall outside and break something!
The Visible band helps me to understand better why I feel the way I do, when I need to take breaks, why I have more energy some days than others. It’s been a great way for me to keep track of good days and bad days.

reviews.title: Helped me before I knew what was wrong
reviews.text: I kept seeing this ad pop up on social media and by this time I had been out of work for 3 months because I could no longer stand or walk without my HR shooting through the roof. All I had was my Apple Watch to show what I was feeling but after countess doctors appointments and countless tests I figured at least this will show that despite all the tests being negative something is wrong. Now I can show the doctors this is what happens when I walk to my kitchen to try to take a shower. Well after a long 6 months I have been diagnosed with Dysautonomia and Visible helps me manage my HR throughout the day. I have 3 kids home through the summer so trying to keep them busy and myself healthy is a balance. I can see where my HR is constantly and when I need to slow down and when I need to sit down.

reviews.title: Great app for people with a verity of health issues
reviews.text: I use this app to track my flairs and my symptoms so I can make better and more informed decisions about my days as well as allowing my doctor to see any patterns

reviews.title: Not useful long term
reviews.text: I found this useful short term but not long term. It didn’t tell me anything new and didn’t really help me pace. I stopped using it when I realized it’s rating me at 5 just because my crash symptoms have been ‘stable’ over 6 weeks. I’ve been in a crash for weeks and it told me I’m a 5 lol. When the symptoms of a crash are consistently high and I’m documenting ‘crash’ for weeks on end, my rating should never be a 5. Thank you

reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.text: I love the visible app so much! It helps a lot with tracking my symptoms and managing my energy levels each day!

reviews.title: Lifesaver -free and subscription versions are great!
reviews.text: Visible has helped me learn to listen to my body’s cues and avoid post-exertion malaise crashes. I used the free version and liked it so much I got the arm band and subscription! Revolutionary compared to fitness tracker apps. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: I Didn’t Realize…
reviews.text: I LOVE my Visible armband and the app so much!!  I didn’t realize how much I needed and depended on my data to plan my daily life UNTIL I lost my charger while I had my knee replacement surgery, and boy during the recovery process I NEEDED IT.

reviews.title: Have already learned a lot
reviews.text: I have been using visible for a short time and have already learned a lot about my symptoms.   I am using it to learn how to manage better and prevent crashing and finding it very helpful.

reviews.title: Life Changing 4 my chronic fatigue
reviews.text: As a chronic fatigue/long covid sufferer, I knew I was supposed to be pacing my energy, but had no idea what I was doing to use up my energy. Visible changed that for me by providing spending points based on HRV! Now I know small things like rushing too much between tasks take my energy too! The support team has always been so quick to answer all my questions and I love using this app and seeing all my info laid out across months. Must have for anyone with chronic anything. Athletes have been using HRV for years, it’s time for this tech & knowledge to be used for us!!

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text: This is a super helpful tool, esp for Type A, athletes who struggle to slow down.

reviews.title: Very helpful!
reviews.text: I love this app! It helps me know when I need to slow down and rest. Only thing I wish they would add is a sleep tracker and walking tracker.

reviews.title: Thank You!!!
reviews.text:
Although I'm new to Visible and still learning, I wanted to reassure those considering this excellent tool that it will help your pacing journey from Day 1. I've been struggling with several autoimmune conditions for years that have been difficult to manage. Although I had tried pacing using another wearable intended for sports, the continuous HR readings and Morning Stability score have made the difference. The Community section in the app and ongoing support from the team have been a tremendous help.
The data points are reassuring and supportive because they make my symptoms visible to me and anyone around me. Taking the time to tag activities has been my eye-opener in setting up a sustainable routine, which I'm working on. The Activity Insights help me plan my day. I can see how the Monthly Check-ins can help guide conversations with my medical team and support my personal goals in conjunction with my Activity Insights. Before Visible, I was sure I was pacing, yet my symptoms didn't improve. It's evident now that I'm using Visible that I wasn't pacing as well as I needed to because I didn't have the correct readings to guide my decisions in planning.
I appreciate all the hard work this fantastic team is doing!

reviews.title: Do not hesitate to get started!
reviews.text: This app has been a game changer for me. It gives you true metrics about your body’s and helps you to make adjustments to your activity levels on a daily basis that has really improved my quality of life. In addition it is great to feel supported and not alone in the misunderstood condition of post exertional malaise.

reviews.title: Visible Saved my Brain!!
reviews.text: A couple of months ago, I didn’t feel well and I noticed that my pace points were getting used way faster than normal. I went to the doctor and was in a hypertensive crisis with high blood pressure.  My doctor doubled my BP med.  if I would not have had the visible armband, I would not have noticed my heart rate increasing.  Strokes run in my family, and I could’ve had a stroke if I would not have known my BP was so high!!  Thank you to everyone at visible for the work that you do, it makes such a huge difference in my life. And I’m grateful!!  I’m so grateful for this life-saving technology, so affordable and available.
